subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexachloroiridate(III)（[IrCl₆]³⁻）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Square planar
D. Square pyramidal
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Ir (group 9) 9 e; 6 × Cl (X) 6 e; the 3− charge adds 3 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −6 in all and the complex has a 3− charge, so the metal is Ir(III), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e.
